description: A gate let through or dropped at random, with the chance of passing set by a voltage

inputs.text: Sets the chance that a rising edge at the Gate input opens the gate output, clamped to 0-10V with no chance at 0V and certain at 10V; the voltage is read only at the moment the edge arrives
The gate being tested, counted as high at 1V and above; each rising edge starts a fresh decision, and once open the output holds until this voltage falls back below 1V

outputs.text: 10V while the gate is open and 0V while it is closed

notes: an unpatched P input reads 0V, which is no chance at all, so the gate output never opens until a voltage is patched there.
the module has no clock of its own; with nothing patched to the Gate input the output stays at 0V.

inputs.0:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
